setup.skills_note: skills_read = published app skills the agent opened in that task. skill_assisted = the subset with a rule written for an action or reading this task needs (our reading of each skill text); opening a skill whose rules do not apply to the task is not counted as assisted.

task.final_summary: Bluetooth is now on. In Settings, the "Use Bluetooth" switch on the Bluetooth screen shows as checked.

steps.note: Observe current screen; then open Settings to toggle Bluetooth on
In Settings, tap Connected devices / Bluetooth
On Connected devices screen, check Bluetooth toggle state and turn it on
On Connection preferences, tap Bluetooth entry to turn it on
On Bluetooth screen, tap the Use Bluetooth toggle to turn it on
Confirm Use Bluetooth switch shows Checked
